_comment: Where rail replacement buses stop at each station, from Southern's poster, which National Rail links from the station's page: built by scripts/fetch_rail_replacement.py from the stops curated in data/rail_replacement_positions.json. app.js draws each on the map and names them on the station's board when a replacement bus is due. Positions are placed by hand from the poster's map: position_basis says how.

stops.name: Station front
stops.position_basis: Placed by hand from the poster's map against OpenStreetMap, to within about 30 m: the south end of The Causeway, on the north side of the station.
stops.source: Southern, Rail Replacement Bus Services: Durrington-On-Sea (poster 2025-01_CI_SN_RRB_DUR_DR)
